in_marathi.name: Atiksha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atiksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Atiksha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ati’ meaning ‘beyond’ and ‘ksha’ meaning ‘desire’ or ‘longing’. This name is often used to describe a deep, intense yearning for something or someone. In Hindu mythology, Atiksha is a name of Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, wisdom, and learning.
